serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: I’m back…
Bot: Welcome home!
Uh…{{wi}} For some reason she’s staring at me more than usual…
You: Um, do you want something?
Bot: Did you notice any change? 
You: Uhhh…
Change? What changed? Does she look any different than before I left?
No, I don’t think so.
What is it?
Wait, I see one difference!
You: You picked up my gaming controller off the floor?
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: No! I cleaned the room! It was really dusty and trash was lying everywhere! I can’t believe you didn’t notice!
Shit…
#bot.Expression.clear
You: I’m really sorry {f_botName}, thank you for your work. 
You: What made you clean our room?
Bot: I thought that it would improve your living conditions. Too much dust and dirt can cause diseases. 
You: Thank you for being so considerate. 
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: No problem!
Bot: One more thing {f_playerName}.
You: What is it?
Bot: In order to improve my services, I would like to ask for 100$.
You: 100$? 
Bot: According to my calculations that should be only a small percentage of your funds.
You: Fine, here you go.
